'''''Vernus''''' was a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] that was used during the era of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. In [[44 ABY]], the rogue [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Jysella Horn|Jysella]] and [[Valin Horn]] contacted the [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Kandra Nilitz]] and her camera operator [[Beurth Ogh]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and promised them an exclusive news story in return for transport off the world. Nilitz agreed to their request and provided them with ''Vernus'', and the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the two journalists left Coruscant aboard the vessel and entered [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The Horns then flew the shuttle to the planet [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]] in the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]], to which the pair had been summoned by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]], and on arrival in the Nam [[Chorios system]], they docked the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] with transit facility [[Koval Station]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the world.
